== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 1 April 2018. The Facebook photo viewer names John Sarnecki. Comments on the photograph address him as John. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 7 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Munster, In). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/john.sarnecki.9. The uncropped original is a two-person photograph; the lead crop is Sarnecki alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:John Sarnecki portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:John Sarnecki Facebook portrait.jpg]].
